SE.rules: A single seat at real size; seat height, depth and back angle realistic for an adult, so a posed figure can sit on it.
SE.negatives: No cushions or throws unless stated, no recognisable designer chair, no gaming-chair branding, no children's chairs.

SO.rules: A sofa, daybed, bed or hanging seat at real size for adults to sit or lie on; beds neatly made with plain bedding as stated.
SO.negatives: No bunk beds, cribs or children's beds, no pillows or throws beyond those stated, no people-shaped dents, no bedding prints with text.

TB.rules: A table, desk or counter at real height (dining 75 cm, coffee 40 cm, counter 105 cm) with an empty top unless stated.
TB.negatives: No objects on the top unless stated, no chairs, no cables, no screens.

ST.rules: A storage or display piece at real size, doors and drawers closed unless stated, shelves holding only the plain items stated.
ST.negatives: No books with readable spines, no branded goods, no mirror reflecting anything but plain grey, no clutter.

CN.rules: Ming or Qing Chinese hardwood furniture with correct mortise-and-tenon construction and the stated period features, natural oiled or lacquered finish.
CN.negatives: No Japanese or Korean features, no carved characters or seals, no religious images, no metal screws or modern hardware, no gilded excess unless stated.

name.ja: 世界・時代のスタイル

WD.rules: A piece accurate to the stated culture or period style, built as a generic example rather than a copy of a named designer piece.
WD.negatives: No named designer reproductions, no royal or national insignia, no religious objects, no mixing of styles.

OD.rules: Outdoor furniture in weather-proof materials at real size, as used in gardens, terraces, parks and beaches.
OD.negatives: No parasols or umbrellas unless stated, no plants, no ground, no plaques with text.

PL.rules: A photographic posing aid or set piece at real size, plain and neutral, made for a model to sit, stand, step, lean or rest an arm on.
PL.negatives: No studio lights or stands, no backdrop, no text or brand marks stencilled on boxes, no props on it.
